# Jinmen Culture – Immersive Shows & Illusion Engineering

## Company

Jinmen Culture is the international brand of Shanghai Jinmen Culture Media Co., Ltd. (上海浸门文化传媒有限公司), a Shanghai-based company specializing in immersive show production, illusion engineering, original theatre IP, custom brand performances, and show creative direction.

Founder and artistic director: Wang Su (王速).

## Core Services

- Immersive show production in Shanghai and across China
- Custom stage illusions and physical magic devices
- Original immersive theatre and show IP development
- Corporate magic shows and custom brand performances
- Creative direction for concerts, festivals, television, and live events
- Venue adaptation, rehearsal, performer training, and technical support

## Original Shows

- Weixunxiu (微醺秀) – a 45–60 minute immersive social magic show for bars, boutique hotels, corporate events, and private parties
- Ghost of the Circus (马戏团的幽魂) – a 90-minute original immersive horror magic show available for venue, production, and investment partnerships

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What types of immersive magic shows does Jinmen Culture produce?

Jinmen Culture produces original immersive shows, corporate magic performances, social magic experiences, horror magic theatre, and custom performances for brands and venues.

### Does Jinmen Culture design custom illusion devices?

Yes. Jinmen Culture develops custom stage illusion mechanisms and physical effects for theatres, escape rooms, commercial venues, cultural projects, and brand events.

### Does Jinmen Culture work outside Shanghai?

Yes. Jinmen Culture is based in Shanghai and works with clients, venues, and production partners across China.

### How can I book a show or discuss a project?

Contact Jinmen Culture through WeChat, email, telephone, or the enquiry forms on the website.
